simple.meaning: אָרוֹן (ʼârôwn) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a box.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 202 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 50:26. Its contexts include death, covenant, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָרוֹן (H727).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אָרוֹן (ʼârôwn) / H727 is traced through Genesis 50:26, Exodus 25:10, Exodus 25:14, Exodus 25:15 as a generated source-based concept entry.
